tex_content.html:
Let $h_0$ be twice the usual metric on the unit sphere in $T_0\Ar ^3$ and let $\rho (x,s)$ be radial exponential coordinates for $g_0$. Then $\rho ^*g_0\le h_0\times ds^2$.
Proof

\sketch The radial component is $ds^2$ and each rotational cross-section has radius at most $\sqrt2$, which gives the tangential inequality.

□
